$comment: vps (build): what runs in Docker and what the host is still allowed to run (decision 2026-10-09: Docker is THE service runtime, no host copy of a containerized service; PostgreSQL, Redis and nginx run in Docker on dbfr). `purge` is applied by scripts/tools/infra/host-purge.ts (idempotent).

containers.aphrody-build: idle build container (compose profile build); builds enter by docker exec

packages.jq nftables microsocks: relay metadata selection (jq), namespace-scoped input firewall (nftables), and private SOCKS5 listener bound to the VPS-to-Mullvad veth; callers use it only through the Windows loopback SSH forward

units.aphrody-desktop-xvfb.service aphrody-des: virtual desktop and VNC on wg1 (host X11)
units.aphrody-mullvad-netns.service aphrody-mu: Japan-only egress namespace, private SOCKS5 listener and loopback-only SSH bridge for Aphrody Web crawl; never changes the VPS default route or public firewall
units.aphrody-site.service: kept native (measured 2026-10-09): static Rust site on public 0.0.0.0:80 (vps.aphrody.com), 4.5 MB RSS, 1.6 ms local response, systemd sandbox (ProtectSystem=strict, only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE, dedicated user); a container adds image and daemon overhead and a Docker-published :80 would bypass ufw
units.user: aphrody-a2a.service aphrody-mcp-ht: A2A hub 23888 and MCP HTTP 23889 for the Windows tunnels (toolbox tools absent from aphrody:runtime)
units.user: aphrody-deploy.timer: Bun fork deploy queue, build role (needs ~/src/bun, gh auth and the wg SSH path to dbfr; the bun-build compose service does not mount them yet)
units.user: aphrody-sync.timer aphrody-site-pu: aphrody fast-forward/build/install, site publication, vLLM CPU fork build

bin./usr/local/bin/bxc-mcp: registered as the `bxc` MCP server in ~/.claude.json
